why: THE MANA BASE, FIRST. deck-audit reads 33 lands against a 36-38 target and mana-fit reads black short by one source and red over by seven, on a deck whose commander costs {B}{R}{R} and whose 21 infect bodies are almost all black. Two rocks out (Fellwar Stone, Talisman of Indulgence), two OWNED black-fetching lands in (Verdant Catacombs, Evolving Wilds): 35 lands, four rocks, the black gap closed, red trimmed by two. The cuts are the two cards a 55-card leave-one-out sweep (6,000 iterations each) could price with the least of its blindness: the sweep ranked Phyrexian Arena, Deadly Dispute and Demonic Tutor as the least needed, which is the goldfish saying it cannot see what card advantage or a tutor does against an unopposed 40 -- those stay. Objective: fewer missed land drops by turn five, with kill_by_8 held (0.80) as the control.
